files.title: File:Bonderson Farm crib barn and cow shed.JPG
files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption: Structures on Ben Bonderson Farm in Dakota County, Nebraska, about four miles east of Emerson, Nebraska; seen from the south.  The farm is listed in the National Register of Historic Places.  The large red building with the cupola and the slatted sides is a drive-in crib barn.  The red building behind it and to its right is a cow shed.  Partly visible at the right edge of the picture is the Quonset machine shed.  Part of a grain bin can be seen at the lower left corner of the picture.
